A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, in the absence of a coligand that saturates metal coordination, the formation of a [M2(μ-S)2] site is a kinetically highly demanding process that requires a high thermodynamic driving force.
the structural assembly of [M2] sites from [2{Mκ-S}] units is thermodynamically highly preferred and kinetically facile.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the formation of the [M2(μ-S)2]+ structure is thermodynamically preferred, but kinetically hindered.
